scripts.instalar: npm install && npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix web
scripts.banco:zerar: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.iniciar: npm run build --prefix web && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm start --prefix api" "npm run preview --prefix web"
scripts.whatsapp:ligar: docker exec vistoria-ecv-banco sh -c "psql -U vistoria -d vistoria_ecv -tAc \"select 1 from pg_database where datname = 'evolution'\" | grep -q 1 || createdb -U vistoria evolution" && docker compose --profile whatsapp up -d whatsapp
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run dev --prefix web"
